culture.text: Staff are mostly electrical and electronics engineers and computer scientists, from schools like TU/e, TU Delft, Politehnica Bucharest and UT Austin.
About 22,295 employees, with operations in more than 30 countries.
Offers online and offline learning to grow your career.

open.text: NXP Semiconductors N.V., NXP Semiconductors Netherlands B.V. and NXP B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: Revenue was US$13.2 billion in 2022 (net profit US$2.8 billion) and US$12.61 billion in 2024, a slight dip.
Named with ASML and VDL as Eindhoven firms eager for technical staff.
Is pushing into 'physical AI' and sees data centre growth.
